title: Spring flow moved earlier faster than the annual flow midpoint at Yenisey-Igarka in certified 1980-2017 data
abstract: We compared annual and April-July flow timing at Yenisey-Igarka with ArcticGRO v20261104. In 38 complete certified years, 1980-2017, the spring flow midpoint moved earlier by 1.50 days per decade. The annual midpoint moved earlier by 0.59 days per decade, with a 95% block interval of -1.70 to 0.57. The annual-minus-spring slope was 0.90 days per decade, with an interval of 0.35 to 1.47. The contrast stayed positive in all six sensitivity checks. January-April flow share had no clear trend. An exploratory test found that August-December share rose by 1.20 percentage points per decade. This is consistent with later-season flow giving more weight to the annual timing measure. It does not prove a cause. One regulated basin, a fixed spring window, short records, conditional uncertainty and provisional data after 2017 limit the result. Code, source hashes, aggregate results, a numerical audit and a figure permit reproduction.

display.caption: Annual and spring timing with certified 1980-2017 fits. The January-April share changed little in that period. Provisional values are shown separately.
